study_note: One fresh H3/J8 inner-SAC Humanoid Walk training run without an auxiliary critic. J8/C16/A4/N128/B256 and the primary outer learning recipe match the launched full AMBI experiments. Both inner initialization and terminal bootstrap use the primary SAC critic, and interior inner-SAC targets are entropy-augmented. The retained finite-horizon boundary uses a sampled outer SAC action and online primary-Q mean_pair bootstrap without an additional terminal entropy bonus. The auxiliary learner is disabled: no auxiliary online/target critic or optimizer is allocated, and its shared-representation loss is removed. No Bernoulli transfer. Sampled actions during training, automatic entropy target -10.5, seed55, 500k decisions (1M raw environment steps), 2500 warmup decisions and 2500 pretraining updates. Retain all checkpoints every25k decisions. Evaluation remains disabled as in the source training recipe; W&B shows actual training returns, diagnostics and costs.
